manifesto.col1Body: Four architectural commissions engineered into a unified digital nervous system. Not a template library, but a bespoke dialogue between editorial taste and mission-critical engineering.
manifesto.col2Body: We accept a select cohort of enterprise partners each quarter so every interaction curve, design token, and edge deployment receives direct principal architect execution.

modules.heading: Four core modules. One unified enterprise stack.

items.name: Kinetic Web Engine
items.copy: A physics-backed web rendering engine with GPU-accelerated transitions and tactile micro-interactions that turn passive traffic into unmistakable enterprise authority.

items.name: Autonomous Cloud Mesh
items.copy: A resilient microservice fabric with predictive load routing across 14 global edge zones, engineered to absorb traffic spikes without frame drops.

items.name: Spatial Design System
items.copy: A centralized design engineering foundation synchronizing color tokens, editorial typography, and accessible primitives from design canvas directly to production.

items.name: Zero-Trust FinTech Core
items.copy: End-to-end hardened security architecture with real-time cryptographic attestation built for financial institutions, digital banking, and enterprise settlement.

cases.heading: Measured outcomes from prior cohorts.
cases.quote: Antigravity Argon is not a template agency. They are a principal engineering atelier that transformed how institutional partners perceive our technology.

items.title: Meridian Quant Institutional Portal
